stat: Margin by which the UK government's statutory Report on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence beat its own 9-month deadline under the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025
method: Recipe F (time-to-comply / deadline analysis) — calendar-day delta between the Act's royal assent date and the report's actual publication date, neither of which the sources state as a single elapsed or margin figure

sources_used.title: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025, Part 7, ss.135-136 (copyright works and artificial intelligence systems)
Report on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
sources_used.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT), Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS), Intellectual Property Office (IPO)

workings: Royal assent of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025: 19 June 2025. Sections 135 and 136 require the report and impact assessment to be published within 9 months of that date, a deadline falling on 19 March 2026. The report was in fact published on 18 March 2026. 19 March 2026 minus 18 March 2026 = 1 calendar day of margin before the statutory deadline would have been missed.
